stem.text: The diagram shows parts of the gas exchange system in humans and the associated cells or structures.
Which diagram shows the lines that correctly match the parts to their cells or structures?

A.alt: Two columns of four empty boxes joined by lines, with two crossing pairs of lines and two straight pairs

B.alt: Two columns of four empty boxes joined by lines, with two straight lines at the top and a crossing pair in the bottom two rows

C.alt: Two columns of four empty boxes joined by lines, with one crossing pair at the top and straight lines at the bottom two rows

D.alt: Two columns of four empty boxes joined by four straight horizontal lines
